lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, choose_path layout, choose_path new_flow, finish redesign, and home new_flow, as each category has only one test.
Adoption redesign is a helpful change, supported by a confirmed statistically significant win in round 3.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path copy, home wait_info, sign_in reorder, finish new_screen, home notification, or sign_in hint across multiple tests.
Finish notification changes showed no clear positive effect, with one test causing a severe drop that required an early stop.
Predictions were often overly optimistic for minor tweaks while severely underestimating major positive wins like the adoption redesign.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Style Selector Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pet choice stage into a stage layout featuring companion style cards and visual choice elements.
candidates.why: Custom pet rendering and selection bugs generated 3 support tickets, and adoption step drop-off is 70.1%.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction First Steps Stage
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated post-onboarding preview screen introducing pet movement, hiding, and chat controls before entering the desktop.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion over controlling or hiding the pet, and finish step conversion is lowest at 64.8%.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_desktop_controls']

candidates.title: Story Prologue After Path Selection
candidates.change: Swaps the onboarding order so users pick their companion path immediately before viewing the background story intro.
candidates.why: Choose path median time is short (8s) but mean is long (514s); letting users pick early increases immediate focus.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Interactive Generation Progress Flow
candidates.change: Rebuilds the waiting step with an interactive checklist layout and progress milestone tracking while pet rendering completes.
candidates.why: Home waiting duration is long (median 201s, mean 2336s) and pet generation fails or stalls, causing user drop-off.

guard.reason: Redesigns the waiting screen layout while keeping its core job of tracking pet creation.

candidates.score_note: High wait time on home, but home new_flow previously regressed conversion by -3.7%.

candidates.title: Account Sync Verification Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explicit explanatory hint on sign in clarifying that companion save states and pet creations sync safely to the account.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or resetting after signing back into an account.

sign_in.hint: Your companion and custom progress are automatically linked and saved to this account.

guard.reason: Adds an informative hint to the sign-in screen without violating fair design or data rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails, but sign_in hint changes have shown no positive lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Quick Tutorial Cards
candidates.change: Updates the home intro screen layout to a two-column view summarizing how to summon, move, and chat with the desktop companion.
candidates.why: Addresses post-onboarding user confusion about controlling and interacting with the desktop pet (3 support emails).

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Ready!
home_intro.body: Learn how to summon, move, and chat with your pet directly on your desktop.

guard.reason: Updates the home intro screen layout within allowed onboarding modifications.

candidates.score_note: Addresses post-onboarding confusion, but layout and finish changes historically underperform.

candidates.title: Pet Customization Safeguard Hint
candidates.change: Displays guidance text on the photo upload screen recommending photo clarity to ensure proper companion rendering.
candidates.why: 3 support emails cited custom pet generation failures or corrupted avatar appearances.

upload_photos.hint: Use well-lit, clear photos for best companion rendering results.

guard.reason: Adds helpful photo quality guidance text on the upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses customization failure emails on adoption step where changes generally perform well.

candidates.title: Companion Path Overview Copy
candidates.change: Revises headline and body text on the choose path screen to clearly explain custom vs pre-made pet path options.
candidates.why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users immediately; clarifying options upfront improves initial activation.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion Path
choose_path.body: Pick between standard archetypes or build a custom pet that lives on your screen.

guard.reason: Revises copy on choose path while retaining both custom and pre-made pet choices.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy edit targeting initial path choice, aligned with +1.8% average measured lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Readiness Notification
candidates.change: Enables live time estimates and status hints on the waiting screen to set expectations during background pet generation.
candidates.why: Home waiting step takes a median of 201s and 3 support emails reported desktop pet opening/display failures.

waiting.hint: Preparing your desktop pet engine... almost ready!

guard.reason: Enables real wait estimates and status updates on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Well-supported by support emails and wait metrics, but home wait_info tests previously lost -1.1%.

candidates.title: Instant Account Access Incentive
candidates.change: Displays a cloud backup status badge during sign-in to motivate account completion and promise pet state protection.
candidates.why: Sign-in step drops 27.1% of users, and missing pets after sign-in is the single largest support complaint (8 emails).

guard.reason: Adds a cloud backup badge to sign-in without deceptive incentives or price mentions.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets the top support issue (8 emails) and a 27.1% sign-in drop with an incentive badge.

lessons_next: Evidence remains thin for adoption hint, adoption new_screen, choose_path layout, choose_path new_flow, finish layout, and finish redesign, as each has only one test.
Adoption redesign and home new_flow changes proved helpful, each producing a confirmed statistically significant win.
No clear effect was seen across multiple tests for choose_path copy, home wait_info, sign_in reorder, finish new_screen, home notification, or sign_in hint.
Finish notification changes showed no positive wins, with one test causing a severe performance drop that forced an early stop.
Predictions consistently overestimated minor tweaks while underestimating major wins like adoption redesign and home new_flow.
